playstyle.identity: Yuumi is an untargetable enchanter who attaches to allies. She provides healing and buffs while being impossible to kill as long as her host survives.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: autos restore mana and shield ally. Q fires a guided missile (buffed when attached). W attaches to ally (untargetable, gives adaptive force). E heals attached ally and gives speed. R waves that root on 3 hits. Attach to carry, detach to proc passive.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Yuumi spikes with mana and AP. Moonstone enhances healing. She's strong attached to a fed carry.

passive.name: Bop 'n' Block
passive.summary: Auto attacks restore mana and shield ally when attached.
passive.details: Yuumi's next auto attack restores mana. If she's attached, she also grants her ally a shield.

abilities.name: Prowling Projectile
abilities.summary: Fire a missile that you can guide; empowered when attached.
abilities.details: Yuumi fires a missile that she can steer. If attached, the missile deals more damage and slows on hit.

abilities.name: You and Me!
abilities.summary: Attach to an ally, becoming untargetable and sharing stats.
abilities.details: Yuumi attaches to an ally, becoming untargetable. She shares her adaptive force with them. She can hop between allies.

abilities.name: Zoomies
abilities.summary: Heal attached ally and grant movement speed.
abilities.details: Yuumi heals herself or her attached ally and grants them bonus movement speed and attack speed.

abilities.name: Final Chapter
abilities.summary: Fire waves that root enemies hit 3 times.
abilities.details: Yuumi channels waves of magic damage. Enemies hit by three waves are rooted. Can be cast while attached.
